purpose: Full Arabic MIRACLRetrieval dense evaluation for Qwen3-Embedding-8B using a resumable corpus embedding cache and chunked top-k scoring.

evaluator.method: direct SentenceTransformer encode_queries/encode_corpus, float16 corpus memmap cache, torch chunked exact top-k scoring
evaluator.note: This is a full-corpus cached dense run, not the earlier 10k diagnostic sample.

interpretation: Qwen3-Embedding-8B completed the full Arabic MIRACLRetrieval corpus under the cached direct dense evaluator with main_score/ndcg_at_10 0.700164.
This does not beat the completed BGE-M3 or multilingual-e5-large-instruct full MIRACL Arabic dense baselines in this repo.
The run validates the cache workflow: full corpus encoding completed in about 12.69 hours and scoring took about 83 seconds.

Because Qwen3 is instruction-aware and this is a direct dense evaluator, future Qwen work should check prompt/template control before treating this as the model family's best possible MIRACL Arabic result.
For immediate full MIRACL Arabic dense teacher selection, BGE-M3 remains the strongest completed baseline.
next_experiment: Do prompt/template research for Qwen3 retrieval or move to BGE-M3 hybrid retrieval; do not claim Qwen3-Embedding-8B as SOTA from this direct dense run.
